description: Linux kernel module source code for a Button Hotplug driver, handling input events for buttons and generating uevents.

classes.name: bh_priv
classes.description: Private data structure for input handle context, including seen button states and input handle.

classes.name: bh_event
classes.description: Represents a button event, including name, action, timestamp, skb buffer, and work struct.

classes.name: bh_map
classes.description: Mapping between button codes and their string names.

methods.name: bh_event_add_var
methods.description: Adds a variable string to the event's skb buffer.

methods.name: button_hotplug_fill_event
methods.description: Fills event with standard environment variables and button info.

methods.name: button_hotplug_work
methods.description: Work handler that sends the uevent via netlink.

methods.name: button_hotplug_create_event
methods.description: Creates and schedules a new button event.

methods.name: button_get_index
methods.description: Returns index of button code in button_map array.

methods.name: button_hotplug_event
methods.description: Input event handler called on button press/release.

methods.name: button_hotplug_connect
methods.description: Handles connection of input device with relevant buttons.

methods.name: button_hotplug_init
methods.description: Module initialization function, registers input handler.

methods.name: button_hotplug_exit
methods.description: Module cleanup function, unregisters input handler.
